svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.18.1.3 Heated and Unheated Crawl Spaces
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.18 CRAWL SPACES

g.text: Used as a hot-air plenum, Clause (1)(a)
Heating duct not sealed and insulated,
Not separated from heated space by
None of (a) to (c): not considered heated

svg.text: Crawl spaces are considered to be heated where
(a) is used as a hot air plenum, (b) contains
heating ducts that are not sealed and insulated
to minimize heat loss to the space, or (c) is not
separated from heated space in accordance with
Heating of heated crawl spaces conforms to
Insulation, an air barrier system and a vapour
barrier are installed in the walls of heated
crawl spaces in accordance with Section 9.25.
Drawn: red arrows show heat, floors in A and C see-through, C with insulated walls and D with an insulated floor. Sizes are illustration only.
